summary.en: In the Asian Games men's singles quarterfinals, Japan's Tomokazu Harimoto lost 3-4 to veteran Iranian Alamian. With Matsushima also out, Japan's men's singles ended without a medal, a stunning collapse just two days after their historic team gold.

summary.zh_hant: 亞運乒乓球男單8強，日本主力張本智和3比4不敵伊朗老將阿拉米揚。隨着松島輝空出局，日本男單無緣獎牌。兩日前先歷史性奪得男團金牌嘅日本隊，單打賽場慘遭滑鐵盧。

summary.en: Su Wen leapt 17.42m on his third attempt to win the men's triple jump, shattering the 17.31m Asian Games record set by Zou Sixin in 1990 that had stood for 36 years. The mark was a personal best and clears the qualifying standard for the 2027 Beijing World Championships; teammate Ma Yinglong took bronze with 16.75m.

summary.en: Zhang Ziyu starred as China beat Chinese Taipei 77-64 in the third-place match to claim women's basketball bronze at the Asian Games on Saturday. The 19-year-old, who at 2.2 metres stands taller than Shaquille O'Neal, scored 14 points and finished with China's highest scoring average of the tournament, with coach Gong Luming predicting she will one day be 'invincible'. Philippines coach Javier Alvarez Garcia tipped her to become one of the world's best.
summary.zh_hant: 中國女籃周六在季軍戰以77：64擊敗中華台北，摘下亞運銅牌。19歲的張子宇攻入14分，身高2米2的她甚至高過奧尼爾，是中國隊本屆得分王。主教練宮魯鳴預言她有朝一日將「無敵」，菲律賓主帥亦看好她成為世界最佳之一。
summary.zh_hans: 中国女篮周六在季军战以77:64击败中华台北，摘下亚运铜牌。19岁的张子宇攻入14分，身高2米2的她甚至高过奥尼尔，是中国队本届得分王。主教练宫鲁鸣预言她有朝一日将「无敌」，菲律宾主帅亦看好她成为世界最佳之一。

summary.en: Lin Shidong beat Japan's Matsushima Terukong 4-2 in the men's singles quarterfinals on the same day he won mixed doubles gold, conquering his mental demons. He advances to the semifinals as China aims to reclaim singles glory.

summary.en: Taiwan's Lin Yun-Ju defeated Hong Kong's 21-year-old Chan Ho-wa 4-1 in the men's singles quarter-finals on September 26, securing at least a bronze and his first Asian Games singles medal. It was Taiwan's first men's singles semi-final appearance in 12 years, since Chuang Chih-yuan in 2014. Lin will next face China's Lin Shidong for a place in the gold-medal match.

summary.en: China's four basketball teams all missed the final in Nagoya: the men's 5x5 side lost 77-97 to Japan in the semifinal and 70-79 to Iran in the bronze game to finish fourth, while the women's team fell 80-85 to South Korea with a stunning 0-for-13 from three, missing the Asian Games final for the first time in 32 years. Both 3x3 squads also bowed out in the quarterfinals. Just eight years after sweeping all four golds at Jakarta 2018, Chinese basketball's slide has sparked calls for a full rebuild of the youth system, league competitiveness and playing philosophy.

Every game was decided by just two points (11-9, 13-11, 11-9, 11-9), with the youngsters completing a remarkable comeback from 2-8 down in the fourth. The mark is the second-fastest in Asian history behind Su's 9.83 Asian record, and Boonsong went sub-10 in all three of his runs at the Games. China's Zeng Keli and Xie Zhenye finished sixth and seventh.

summary.en: Manchester City plan to fight the Premier League for months after reports — first by The Athletic and the BBC — that an independent panel upheld nearly all of the 100-plus financial charges laid in 2023 over misleading financial reporting from 2009 to 2018. The club, which has always denied wrongdoing, called the process 'ongoing' and will appeal any guilty verdict, with sanctions from a huge points deduction to expulsion undecided. The bombshell comes after Pep Guardiola stood down as manager at the end of last season.
summary.zh_hant: 據The Athletic及BBC報導，獨立仲裁小組裁定曼城2023年被控的逾百項財務違規中幾乎全部成立，涉2009至2018年九年間財報失實。球會堅稱清白、強調程序「仍在進行」，表明將上訴，抗爭可能拖延數月；處罰由巨額扣分到逐出英超皆未定。消息在哥迪奧拿上季末離任後傳出，震撼球壇。

title.en: 17-year-old Chen Yujie wins Asian Games women's 100m gold in 11.06 seconds
title.zh_hant: 11秒06！17歲陳妤頡奪得亞運女子百米金牌
title.zh_hans: 11秒06！17岁陈妤颉夺得亚运女子百米金牌

summary.en: China's Chen Yujie won the women's 100m final at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in 11.06 seconds on September 25 local time. The 17-year-old's victory makes her the new 'queen of the Asian sprint'.
summary.zh_hant: 中國選手陳妤頡在愛知·名古屋亞運會女子100米決賽中跑出11秒06，強勢奪金。年僅17歲的她成為新一代「亞洲女飛人」。
